versions.notes: v1.4.4 (code 26): Draft vouchers get their own screen — reachable from More → Draft vouchers; lists every parked sale (label, saved time, game/mins/payment/food summary) with the total parked value, Delete per entry, Delete all, and Restore & finish which loads the draft into New Sale. The draft is removed automatically once that sale is saved.

v1.4.3 (code 25): New Sale — Save as draft. The whole sale (member, console, game, mins, food cart, split payments, discount, promo/coupon state) is snapshotted to the device, so a voucher can be parked when the money is only settled later; Drafts (N) opens the list to Restore or Delete, and restoring puts everything back so Save Sale can finish it. Drafts never touch the server.

v1.4.2 (code 24): speed — the read path now caches. apiCached upgraded to stale-while-revalidate with a localStorage-persisted store (instant first paint after an app restart) and any successful write invalidates the cache. 101 read call sites switched from PSV.api to PSV.apiCached (slow-changing lists cache 2-10 min, the rest 15 s); realtime/auth endpoints stay uncached.

v1.4.1 (code 23): Stock in / Sales dropdowns — the big wheel pickers (van-picker with tall rows, no search) are replaced by the compact searchable PSVPicker sheet: item picker in Stock In, payment pickers in Stock In / New Sale / Top-up and the game picker in New Sale. Tap a row to select, search box auto-appears for long lists.

v1.4.0 (code 22): member-card voucher — for wallet plays the receipt now shows the GAME MINUTES and 'Game amount: 0 Ks (card)' instead of the game price, plus a MEMBER BALANCE breakdown (before / deducted / after) parsed from the sale notes; Paid shows 'Member card (mins)' and the cash TOTAL stays the net amount.

v1.3.9 (code 21): FIX — the logo did not print because the blank-line trimmer treated the image line (which has no text) as a blank line and dropped it; image lines now count as content. The PS VIBE logo (with the wordmark, 632x168 black on white) prints centred at 340 dots at the top of the voucher.

v1.3.8 (code 20): the receipt header now prints the REAL PS VIBE logo (the artwork that includes the wordmark) as an image — bundled at assets/print/psvibe-logo.png (auto-cropped, black on white, 632x168), drawn centred at the top of the voucher. The native renderer gained image-line support ({img, size, align}) for asset:/data: sources, with a text fallback for builds that cannot render images.

v1.3.7 (code 19): tighter receipt per owner 15:19 — leading/trailing empty voucher lines are dropped, top/bottom padding 10 -> 6 dots, and the pre-cut feed reduced 6 -> 4 LF (~15mm) because the bottom still had too much blank paper.

v1.3.6 (code 18): fixes v1.3.5 which shipped WITHOUT the Lexend font (the download redirected and left a 0-byte file) — the bundled Lexend variable TTF is now really inside the APK, English/number lines print in Lexend, Myanmar lines keep Noto Sans Myanmar; font dots -2px (title 52 / wide 38 / body 30); receipt top/bottom padding reduced to 10 dots; pre-cut feed 6 LF.

v1.3.5 (code 17): print polish per owner 15:15 — font dots another -2px (title 52 / wide 38 / body 30), English lines now print in the bundled Lexend font (Myanmar lines keep Noto Sans Myanmar), and the receipt's top/bottom padding reduced to 10 dots (side margin unchanged so edges stay clean).

v1.3.4 (code 16): print fine-tuning after the raw ESC/POS path was confirmed good at 80mm — voucher dot metrics reduced ~10% (title 54 / wide 40 / body 32) because the owner found them a little too big, and the pre-cut feed cut from 12 LF to 6 LF (~22mm) because the auto-cut left too much blank paper below the receipt.

v1.3.3 (code 15): NEW raw ESC/POS voucher path (printVoucherRaw) — renders at exactly 576 dots (80mm) in-app and writes GS v 0 raster bands straight to the printer stream, so the DantSu library cannot scale or centre the receipt (root cause of the 384-dot / 48mm tiny prints). No paper-profile dependency, 12-line feed + auto-cut, toast reports 576 dots (80mm).

v1.3.2 (code 14): vouchers are PINNED to 80mm/576 dots on both the app side (printVoucherNative forces the 80mm profile) and the web side (setPaperWidth(80) + 576px raster canvas) so a stale 58mm profile can never shrink the receipt again (root cause of 'receipt too small / not 80mm'); native text metrics raised to title 60 / wide 44 / body 36 dots; print toast now reports the real dot width

v1.3.1: self-contained APK (UI bundled) + native voucher print pinned to 80mm/576-dot with enlarged metrics (title 56 / wide 40 / body 32), margin 26 + word wrap, 12-line feed + auto-cut; API calls from the bundled UI now use the public origin with CORS allowlisted for the Capacitor origins

Self-contained UI bundled in the APK (no remote web app) + native in-app voucher print (Android Canvas, Myanmar-safe). Receipt pinned to 80mm/576-dot; enlarged metrics body 32 / wide 40 / title 56, line spacing size+12. versionCode 12 / 1.3.0
Voucher size fix: raster lines now map to the printer's native dot sizes (48/32/24) instead of 1:1 pixels, so Burmese vouchers print at the same size as the text path

Timeline: confirmed upcoming visible until window end + banner-aware one-screen fit; print: Burmese rendered as raster (no more ??), cost per item (@unit) on vouchers, footer feed 12 lines so the cutter no longer chops it
Timeline: confirmed upcoming bookings stay visible until the window ends (owner fix 11:43) + food itemised on vouchers + member wallet deduct detail + စမှတ် (no timer) start option
Timeline spec v2 (Active+confirmed upcoming, forfeit 1h, 1-screen fit)
Printer: longer feed before cut (footer was chopped)
Printer quality v2: auto-cut + crisp text + 58/80mm + opt. density
Printer pairing UI + web cache-bust entry URL (print fix)
Update-flow test build (auto-download banner test)

In-app self-update: old app detects new version (start/resume/6h/refresh), 'Update now' downloads the APK inside the app with a progress bar, then opens the Android installer (falls back to browser download on old builds). Requires Android 'install unknown apps' permission.

Bookings ops (approve/reject/check-in/cancel, deposit verify+redeem), promo/coupon, sessions move/swap, inventory stock-out/check/alerts, report+balances, attendance check-out, gift card, rank/bonus, notification centre, 80mm printing. English UI.
